MEMORANDUM OF TENANCY

This memorandum records the terms agreed between Sunita Deshmukh, the owner of Flat No. 402, Sunrise Residency, Pune (the "Owner"), and Arjun Kulkarni (the "Occupant").

The Occupant shall pay rent of Rs. 15,500 every month by the 5th, and a deposit of Rs. 93,000 held against damages and dues, returnable within a month of the Occupant leaving.

The Occupant will stay for eleven months from 1st February 2026, after which the arrangement may continue month to month if both sides agree in writing.

If either side wants to end this arrangement, one month's notice in writing must be given.

The Owner takes care of major repairs; the Occupant handles small day-to-day upkeep and pays for electricity and water as per actual consumption.

The Occupant shall not pass on or share the premises with anyone else without the Owner saying so in writing, and shall not run any business from the premises.
